Rashi on Pesachim 119a:12:1.english: That stands him upon his feet - For it gladdens his heart.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:12:3.hebrew: וקולפי - פותחות, שקורין בלעז שרדור"א (שירידור"א: מנעול):
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:12:3.english: And locks [ve-kulfei] - Locks, which are called serreüre in Old French (serreüre: lock).

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:12:4.english: Of leather - Of leather sacks that are carried on horses, donkeys, and camels.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:13:1.hebrew: אבן מאסו הבונים - כלומר דוד, שמימיו רועה צאן היה ונעשה ראש. ו"נפלאת בעינינו", לשון רבים, אמרו אחיו:
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:13:1.english: The stone [which] the builders rejected - That is to say, David, who all his days was a shepherd of sheep and became a head [i.e., leader]. And "it is marvelous in our eyes," [which is in] the plural, his brothers said [it].

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:13:2.hebrew: זה היום עשה ה' - שמואל היה מתנבא עליהם שסופן לגיל ולשמוח, שיושיעם מיד אויביהם:
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:13:2.english: This is the day which the Lord has made - Samuel was prophesying about them that in the end they would rejoice and be glad, for He would save them from the hand of their enemies.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:14:1.hebrew: הושיעה נא אמרו אחיו - כלומר, על ידי דוד. ודוד אמר הצליחה נא, שיצליח במלכותו:
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:14:1.english: "Save now," his brothers said - That is to say, on account of David. And David said, "Make [us] prosper now," [meaning] that he should succeed in his kingship.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:14:2.english: Bind the festival [offering] with cords - Bring many sacrifices and peace-offerings to rejoice.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:14:3.hebrew: ברכנוכם אמר שמואל - שיברך כולם, כלומר מברכין אנו אתכם:
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:14:3.english: "We bless you," Samuel said - [Meaning] that he would bless all of them; that is to say, "We bless you."

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:14:4.english: [To] us - [This is in] the plural form.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:14:5.english: Bind the festival [offering] with cords - Bring many sacrifices and peace-offerings to rejoice.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:1:1.hebrew: זה המכיר מקום חבירו בישיבה - שיודע לומר זה מקום מיושב לפלוני וזה של פלוני, דהואיל ומכיר הוא מקום כולם, רגיל הוא לישב שם תמיד:
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:1:1.english: This is one who recognizes his colleague's place in the yeshiva - [Meaning] that he knows to say, "This is a seat designated for so-and-so, and this [is] so-and-so's"; for since he recognizes everyone's place, he is accustomed to sitting there always.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:2:1.english: Secrets of the Torah - The Act of the Chariot and the Act of Creation.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:3:1.hebrew: למנצח - מדלא כתיב לנצח, משמע שנותן כח לבריות לנצחו:
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:3:1.english: Lamenatzeaḥ - Since it is not written lenatzeaḥ ["to conquer"], it implies that He gives strength to [His] creatures to conquer Him.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:4:1.hebrew: לולי משה בחירו - אלמא משתבח ביה קרא במשה, וקרי ליה בחירו משום דהשיב חמתו מהשחית, אלמא שמח הוא בכך:
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:4:1.english: Had not Moses His chosen - Thus Scripture praises Moses, and calls him "His chosen" because he turned back His wrath from destroying; thus He rejoices in this.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:5:1.hebrew: מפני מדת הדין - שמקטרגת ואומרת לא תקבלם, והוא מקבלם בסתר:
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:5:1.english: From before the attribute of justice - Which prosecutes and says, "Do not accept them," and He accepts them in secret.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:7:1.hebrew: כמצודה זו - שפורסים לעופות לצוד, ואין בה דגן, ואין עוף נפנה אליה:
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:7:1.english: Like this trap - That they spread for birds to trap [them], and there is no grain in it, and no bird turns toward it.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:8:1.hebrew: מלחמתו של זרח במצרים — גמרא, אבל מלחמת זרח באסא — קראי:
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:8:1.english: Zerah's war in Egypt [is known from] tradition, whereas Zerah's war against Asa [is recorded in] Scriptural verses.

Rashi on Pesachim 119a:9:1.hebrew: ושיגרו להדרימון - מלך ארם, לעזור לו על בעשא מלך ישראל. וקראי נינהו, ומלחמת יהושפט בעמונים קראי. ודרך הראשונים להביא גנזיהם עמהם במלחמתם, כדי שימשך לבם אחר ממונם ולא יברחו:
Rashi on Pesachim 119a:9:1.english: And he sent it to Hadrimmon - [the] king of Aram, to help him against Baasha, king of Israel. And they are [explicit] verses, and Jehoshaphat's war against the Ammonites [is also in] verses. And it was the way of the ancients to bring their treasuries with them into their battle, so that their hearts would be drawn after their wealth and they would not flee.

Tosafot on Pesachim 119a:7:1.hebrew: כמצודה שאין בה דגן - דרך ציידי עופות להשים דגן במצודה; ודריש "וינצלו" — "וינצלו", כי למ"ד מתחלפת בדל"ת במקומות הרבה:
Tosafot on Pesachim 119a:7:1.english: Like a trap [metzudah] in which there is no grain - It is the way of bird trappers to place grain in a trap. And he expounds "vayenatzlu" [as] "vayenatzlu" [i.e., vayenatzdu, "they trapped"], because lamed interchanges with dalet in many places.
